purpose: Upper bound on AT chip-event batch capacity for a future 80386 block executor; not a safe decoded-block length or speedup measurement
command: XV6_LEAN=1 XV6_FIRMWARE=bochs XV6_STEPS=40000000 XV6_STOP_ON_EXPECT=1 XV6_COMMAND=$'forktest\r' XV6_EXPECT_SERIAL=$'fork test OK\n$ ' node --import ./scripts/measure-i80386-event-horizon.mjs scripts/probe-xv6-stock.mjs
interpretation: 95.92% of observed retired instructions fit complete 64-instruction intervals, and 78.22% fit complete 256-instruction intervals between chip settlements. Guest branches, faults, memory-mapped I/O, self-modifying code, page-table changes, interrupts and debug boundaries can shorten an executable block further. The 3,228 machine steps above the retired-instruction counter include non-retiring/idle boundaries; they are not native-executable instructions. No WASM or native block path was run in this measurement.
